title: [BUG] Docs feedback widget unresponsive
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [X] Other: Documentation website
- Claude CLI version: N/A
- Operating System: macOS 15.4.1
- Terminal:  N/A

## Bug Description
On your docs site the feedback button doesn't seem to be working, or at least it doesn't provide any feedback to the user.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dedffbd9-0ca3-40e4-b681-1957667092bf)

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to https://docs.anthropic.com/en/resources/prompt-library/polyglot-superpowers (MacOS, Chrome browser)
2. Click the feedback buttons

## Expected Behavior
<!-- What you expected to happen -->
I am expecting to see one of the buttons stay selected or for a dialogue to pop-up with the ability to provide extra feedback
## Actual Behavior
Neither button was selected

## Additional Context
<!-- Add any other context about the problem here, such as screenshots, logs, etc. -->
